name: Cabinet
description: A lightweight self-hosted file cabinet and document manager.
summary: Cabinet v0.4.4 (2026-05-23) is the largest release since v0.4.0 (169 commits), introducing Rooms (isolated workspaces), full internationalization across 40 locales with RTL support, an Integrations Hub for Slack/Discord/Google via MCP, and a mobile-responsive layout. v0.4.0 (2026-04-30, 433 commits) added a Skills system, multi-provider BYOAI runtime (8 CLI providers), Terminal mode, a Tasks Board v2, and world-class Cmd+K search. A data migration is required for v0.4.4 as the data root structure changed to support Rooms. Full release notes are available at https://github.com/hilash/cabinet.

answers.Is the project actively maintained?: Yes — multiple releases per month in 2026, most recently v0.4.4 on 2026-05-23
answers.Does it support user authentication?: Not explicitly documented in the changelog; onboarding captures name/email with consent, but no auth system is described

breaking_excerpts: Rooms migration (v0.4.4): data/ is now a neutral 'home' container; the data root is no longer a working cabinet. Existing installs migrate automatically (data is backed up first).
Removed the status-bar page-scoped AI edit composer and redundant task-page back buttons in favor of sidebar navigation (v0.4.4).
cabinetai CLI refuses to bootstrap in $HOME or / and recommends ~/Documents/Cabinet (v0.4.4).

alternatives.name: Paperless-ngx
alternatives.review: Paperless-ngx offers far more powerful OCR, tagging, and document indexing than Cabinet, but is significantly heavier to self-host and configure.

alternatives.name: Docspell
alternatives.review: Docspell provides advanced document processing and metadata extraction but requires more infrastructure setup compared to Cabinet's lightweight approach.

alternatives.name: Teedy
alternatives.review: Teedy is a more feature-rich document management system with workflow support and user permissions, making it heavier but more suitable for teams than Cabinet.

alternatives.name: Nextcloud
alternatives.review: Nextcloud is a comprehensive platform that covers file storage and document management alongside many other apps, but is far more complex to maintain than Cabinet.

alternatives.name: Filestash
alternatives.review: Filestash is similarly lightweight and self-hostable but focuses more on connecting to various storage backends rather than document management and organization.
